mapper.select: SELECT POLICY_KEY, UNDER_TARGET_SECONDS, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM ALERT_POLICY WHERE POLICY_KEY = 'ANIMAL_SHORTAGE'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ALERT_POLICY target USING ( SELECT #{policyKey} AS POLICY_KEY FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.POLICY_KEY = source.POLICY_KEY) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.UNDER_TARGET_SECONDS = #{underTargetSeconds}, target.UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, target.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (POLICY_KEY, UNDER_TARGET_SECONDS, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{policyKey}, #{underTargetSeconds}, #{updatedBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
